EmailTemplate.description: General Case Management Template for Sun Devil Card Services
EmailTemplate.name: Case Mgmt | Sun Devil Card Services Online Staff Instructions
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Extended campus employees may obtain a Sun Card without having to visit one of our offices. To get your Sun Card visit our Photo Upload Portal. https://cfo.asu.edu/cardservices-photo
Once you have read the photo upload guidelines, click on UPLOAD YOUR PHOTO NOW. https://webapp4.asu.edu/cardservices/
Here you will upload the photo for your ASU ID as well as verification ID (driver’s license, passport, US visa). Please allow 1-2 business days for your photo to be approved.
You will receive an email once your photo has been approved. At this point you need to submit a Sun Card Request Form. https://cfo.asu.edu/campus-id-card-request-form
On the request form select “extended campus employee”.
After we have processed your request, we will send you a confirmation email. The card is free if it is your first card. If this is a replacement card, a fee of $25.00 will be applied to your account within a few business days.
Regards, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
